title: The crab boats in
logline: The crab boats tied up at the launch in May, pots stacked, gulls, a man in plaid from behind on the launch's rail with the pup. The boats the Derby's flyers are for, drawn plainly.

panels.composition: Crab boats tied at a boat launch with pots stacked on the dock, gulls, a man in plaid from behind at the rail with a small three-legged dog beside him.
